declaration.selection_rule: Require all requested development runs to succeed and mean correct-chart semantic chord-quality loss versus frozen old correct charts <=10 percentage points for each acoustic backend separately. Among eligible options minimize corrupt retained wrong-label seconds, then maximize correct coverage, then prefer declared option order. If none qualifies, report no acceptable policy; freeze the all-success option with least maximum per-backend quality loss solely for diagnostic validation, without relaxing the eligibility constraint. No validation tuning or Wonderwall calibration.

validation.cached_feature_policy: One spectral extraction per case; immutable same arrays shared by old/new calls. Existing frozen old outputs retain original bytes. Hash-paired native NNLS packets reused without extraction/model inference.
validation.metric_definition: Duration-weighted exact quality/root scores retain extensions and suspensions, exclude slash-bass from quality and report N/X separately. Correct-chart timing is conditional on supplied labels/order/count. Boundary F1 uses ordered one-to-one 150ms matching including N/X gaps; matched timing error excludes missed/extra boundaries. Correct raw labels discarded are computed by three-way interval overlap. Group rates are successful-case means except explicitly duration_weighted values; seconds/counts are additive. Failures remain requested denominators.
limitations: No independent full-song/Wonderwall quality or timing gold is available; Wonderwall is not calibration data.
Historical holdout outcomes were reported in the prior screen, so it is not a pristine blind holdout. This runner never uses its outcomes to select thresholds.
Fresh procedural cases may share synthesis/scoring conventions; success does not establish real guitar or catalogue accuracy.
Supplying labels and order makes this acceptance/conditional alignment evaluation, not chord recognition.
Rejection can reduce wrong labels by discarding correct labels; report both accepted coverage and true-correct-label loss.
Cosine/added-note scores are uncalibrated acoustic evidence, not probabilities. Native NNLS windows limit physical boundary precision.

bounded_runner_assumptions: Normal CLI requires nonempty cases; direct empty-row report helper is outside this run.
All evaluated untimed sequences omit N/X. Silent-position metric counts all targets; these targets are all harmonic in this run. Explicit-N charts need a separately scoped gate.
